canon_hooks.native_excerpt: For a time, the whereabouts of Nurah Dendiwhar were completely {d|c2 nurah trickster}unknown{/d}, but then the River Kingdoms saw the publication of her shocking book — "To the Abyss and Back: The Crusade Through the Eyes of a Former Cultist". The book was banned in several countries, and a bounty was placed on Nurah's head — but the elusive writer always escaped the clutches of the inquisitors.
